newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PTT to cooperate in TNT options probe.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PTT to cooperate in TNT options probe.

text.p: Koninklijke PTT Nederlanden said on Friday it would cooperate with an Australian investigation into possible insider trading of TNT options, but did not expect any of its employees to have been involved.

"We're only involved on the sidelines but chairman Wim Dik said he will offer all the necessary cooperation to see whether the leak was at KPN. We reckon this is almost unthinkable," a spokesman for the part-privatised post and telecoms firm said.

Australia's corporate regulator won court approval on Friday to freeze millions of Australian dollars in trading profits while it investigated possible insider trading ahead of a takeover bid this week by KPN for TNT Ltd.
KPN made a public offer of A$2.45 per TNT share, a 48 percent premium over the share price prior to the announcement.
